quote.text: There is nothing so disturbing to one’s well-being and judgment as to see a friend get rich.
quote.author: Charles P. Kindleberger, Manias, Panics, and Crashes (1978). The wording varies between editions and this desk could not fix it to a page.

stories.kicker: The World · El Salvador In Haiti
stories.headline: Bukele says his forces destroyed 400 Mawozo’s headquarters outside Port-au-Prince
stories.dek: About 2,000 Salvadoran soldiers are now in Haiti. Roughly 200 of them answer to the United Nations-authorised force; the agreement covering the rest has never been published.

stories.headline: Anthropic registers a US$74bn offering, and its own suppliers are buying the shares
stories.dek: Google signed a ten-billion-dollar purchase agreement on 10 November, filed as exhibit 10.15. Against that sit roughly US$900bn of committed payments for computing power.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The December Meeting
stories.headline: Fed governor Waller leans toward a December rise; markets price 88.8 per cent
stories.dek: American core inflation printed 0.3 per cent on Tuesday, a third month without improvement. The Bureau of Labor Statistics published no annual rate at all: October 2025 was never collected.

stories.headline: Singapore police confirm an investigation into Megaspeed, the Nvidia customer at Ocean Financial Centre
stories.dek: Megaspeed’s assets rose from US$33m in 2023 to US$3bn in 2024. The Home Affairs Ministry says flatly that its former managing director was never under investigation here.

stories.kicker: The Atelier · The Mortar And Pestle
stories.headline: Motoshige hand-cuts the grooves in a ¥462 suribachi that Rikumo resells at US$43.50
stories.dek: America’s Test Kitchen rejected every mortar under five pounds. Singapore’s main kitchenware retailer stocks three, all under 14cm and all below its useful-capacity floor.

stories.headline: Sigma’s fp2 ships at S$2,888 in Singapore, without a mechanical shutter
stories.dek: Richard Butler measured the sensor at 14.2 milliseconds and scored the camera 89 per cent. He also found a high-dynamic-range pipeline that cannot be turned off.

stories.kicker: The Good Life · Geneva Watch Auction XXIV
stories.headline: Phillips sells an F.P. Journe Résonance for CHF 8,680,500, eight times its estimate
stories.dek: The Geneva sale made CHF 92,045,568 — the first watch auction to pass a hundred million US dollars. Thirteen Journe lots were more than a third of the total.

stories.headline: Godzilla Minus Zero opens to US$30.6m across 3,254 American screens
stories.dek: Rotten Tomatoes has it at 91 per cent from 192 critics. Little White Lies’ David Jenkins calls it “a pale, radiation-blackened shadow of the 2023 film”.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · Nagata In Pediatrics
stories.headline: A five-wave study in Pediatrics finds social media and low mood predict each other
stories.dek: Nagata and colleagues followed 11,279 American children from age twelve. The effects run between 0.03 and 0.07, every anxiety path crosses zero, and one co-author is an expert witness in social-media litigation.

stories.headline: The Central Council counts Britain’s change ringers for the first time since 1988
stories.dek: The Central Council’s census runs 16 to 22 November. Its own estimate is that the 41,000 ringers of 1988 are now about 30,000, and that 60 per cent of them are over sixty.

stories.headline: A Surrey trial finds a longevity supplement lifts artery function by 2.9 points
stories.dek: European Heart Journal Open published it on 4 November. The placebo group was seven years older than the treatment group, and every blood-lipid result was null.

stories.kicker: The Diary · Two Deadlines, One Premiere
stories.headline: Gardens by the Bay opens The Story of Studio Ghibli on 18 December
stories.dek: Resident tickets are $39 adult and $29 child, on sale now. ART SG’s two-for-one offer ends at 11.59pm on 24 November, and sumo tickets open at 10am Japan time on 5 December.

stories.headline: Ulaanbaatar sold 1,600 street kiosks, then cleared the streets for CU
stories.dek: Governor’s Order A230 of 14 February 2025 began the clearance. Premium Nexus opened its 603rd Korean-branded store in June, and its loyalty app now holds 1.3 million registrations in a country of 3.5 million.
